items.description: Each income or expense account with a total in either period.

next_cursor.description: Pass it as cursor for the next page; absent on the last page.

previous_period.description: The period it is compared with: the one that ends the day before it starts; absent when there is none, and then there is nothing to compare.

threshold_amount.description: A variance needs an explanation when its size is more than this (setting close.variance_amount)…

threshold_percent.description: …and more than this percentage of the previous total's size (setting close.variance_percent); when the previous total is zero the amount alone decides.

unexplained.description: How many variances, on every page, need an explanation and have no current one: the close checks refuse the close while there are any.
